name: SK Hynix
day_summary: SK Hynix extended its all-time high streak on the June 19 KOSPI session (KRX closed 06:30 UTC) with a third consecutive ATH close at ₩2,764,000 — +2.94% (+₩79,000) from the June 18 close of ₩2,685,000. Session range: ₩2,688,000–₩2,891,000 (intraday high of ₩2,891,000 before a partial pullback to the close). This is the third consecutive session of ATH closes, the longest streak since the stock's 2025 re-rating. KOSPI crossed 9,000 for the first time in history on June 18 — a milestone driven primarily by SK Hynix and Samsung's weight in the index (~50% combined). On June 19, the KOSPI continued its historic momentum. The key fundamental driver: TradingKey confirmed SK Hynix shipped HBM4E samples 'as soon as this month' — approximately three weeks after Samsung's first HBM4E shipment (May 29). This is the technology leadership confirmation: SK Hynix delivered HBM4E samples ON SCHEDULE, before the customer qualification process that will determine supply allocation for mass production in 2027. With the 38-analyst consensus average PT of ₩2,690,000 now ₩74,000 below the current price, the sell-side PT revision cycle is underway. Market cap: ~₩1,969.91T (~$1.28T at ₩1,537/USD). Year-to-date return: ~+314%.
long_pnl: +2.94% on the KOSPI June 19 session; third consecutive ATH; longs from any entry below June 18's ₩2,685,000 close are in the money; the HBM4E sample-shipping confirmation is a product-cycle milestone not yet fully priced into sell-side models (consensus PT still ₩2,690,000); every hour without a new sell-side PT upgrade above ₩3.0M represents accumulation opportunity
short_pnl: fourth nightmare session counting pre-ATH run-up: stock has now delivered +314% YTD and three consecutive ATH closes; there is no near-term technical resistance level (ATH stocks by definition have no overhead supply); the HBM4E sample confirmation removes the primary structural bear argument (Samsung catching up before SK Hynix can ship)
